Draft/Notes:
Subject: Request for a quieter meeting room

Hi Facilities Team,

Could you help me find a quieter meeting room for [team/meeting name]? Our current room, [room name/number], is frequently affected by noise from [hallway/elevator/adjacent area], which makes it hard to hear and to run productive discussions. We usually meet on [day(s)] at [time] for about [duration], with [number] attendees.

Could you recommend or reassign us to a room that’s more secluded or better soundproofed (preferably a room with a closing door and away from high-traffic areas)? If you can’t move the existing reservation, please let me know available alternatives and the next steps to book one. I’m flexible on time and can test a room if needed.

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Team / Title]
[Phone or extension]
